description: Explain WHAT DRIVES the returns of a ticker, ETF or built-in portfolio by decomposing them into common factor exposures (market, size, value, momentum, quality, low-volatility, duration, credit) plus an idiosyncratic residual. Use this when the user asks why two assets move together, what a fund is really exposed to, whether a stock is a growth or value tilt, how much of a return is just market beta, whether it has real alpha, or what is driving a portfolio's returns. Returns betas (loadings), t-stats, an additive variance decomposition (shares sum to R²), annualized alpha, idiosyncratic vs total volatility, and for a portfolio the holdings that drive each factor. Computed by OLS regression on real price history via tradeable ETF proxies (long-short factor spreads): measured exposure, not a forecast. Provide exactly one of `target` (a ticker, computed live), `template` (a built-in model portfolio) or `strategy` (a canonical strategy); portfolio ids are answered from precomputed monthly data through the stated month with the five default factors (market, size, value, duration, credit) and ignore `frequency` and `factors`. For performance numbers use analyze_portfolio. Read-only.

factors.description: Factor ids to include. Default: MKT, SMB, HML, TERM, CREDIT (long history back to ~2001). All available: MKT, SMB, HML, MOM, QMJ, LOWVOL, TERM, CREDIT. The smart-beta trio (MOM, QMJ, LOWVOL) only has history from ~2011-2013, which shortens the analyzable window — factors without enough overlap are dropped and reported.

frequency.description: Return frequency for the regression of a `target` ticker. Monthly (default) is standard for factor analysis. Ignored for `template` / `strategy` (always monthly).

strategy.description: Canonical rule-based strategy whose returns to decompose, e.g. dual-momentum-gem. One of: dual-momentum-gem, tsmom-sp500, faber-trend-timing, sector-momentum-rotation, risk-parity-inverse-vol, gtaa-aggressive, adaptive-asset-allocation. Precomputed; default factors.

target.description: Yahoo Finance ticker to decompose, e.g. AAPL, QQQ, TLT, ARKK. Omit when using `template` or `strategy`.

template.description: Built-in model portfolio whose returns to decompose, e.g. all-weather. One of: golden-butterfly, all-weather, permanent, dragon, faber-ivy, faber-gaa, bogleheads-3fund, wealthfront-classic, betterment-core, classic-60-40, classic-40-60, swensen, ferri-core-four, couch-potato, coffeehouse, no-brainer, larry, buffett-90-10, total-sp500. Precomputed; default factors.

name: decompose_factors
